hrmsLeave.title: Leave
hrmsLeave.subtitle: Requests waiting for a decision, everyone’s balances, who is away when, and the leave rules.

bits.noLimitTaken: No balance needed · {{days}} taken this year

accruals.ANNUAL_UPFRONT: All at the start of the leave year

accrualHints.ANNUAL_UPFRONT: The year’s days are there from the first day of the leave year. Someone who joins later gets the months that are left.
accrualHints.MONTHLY: A twelfth of the year’s days is added on the 1st of each month, in half days.
accrualHints.ON_CONFIRMATION: Nothing while on probation. From the confirmation date they get the rest of that year, then the full number every year.
accrualHints.NONE: No days are added by themselves. HR gives them when needed — or switch on “No balance needed” below.

kinds.COMP_OFF: Compensatory off for a day worked

hint.REPORTING_MANAGER: The reporting manager on their staff record. When none is set, or they have no login, the principal / HR decides instead.
hint.DEPARTMENT_HEAD: The head set on their department (Administration › Departments). When none is set, the principal / HR decides instead.
hint.HR: Anyone whose role can approve leave — usually the principal and the HR office. Any one of them can decide.
hint.SPECIFIC_USERS: The people you pick below. Any one of them can decide.
hint.ROLE: Anyone holding the roles you pick below, for example the Vice principal. Any one of them can decide.

requests.search: Search by name or staff code…
requests.emptyMineHint: Requests come here when it is your turn to approve them.
requests.emptyMineOthers_one: {{count}} request is waiting with someone else.
requests.emptyMineOthers_other: {{count}} requests are waiting with someone else.

chain.approvedByInstead: Approved by {{name}}, in place of this step’s approver
chain.sinceMovesOn: Waiting since {{time}} · moves on after {{hours}} hours without a decision
chain.escalated: Moved on — no decision in time
chain.standsIn: The principal / HR decides here because {{reason}}.

decide.approveFinal: This is the last step: the days come off their balance and show as leave in staff attendance.
decide.approveInstead: It is waiting for {{who}}. You can decide it in their place — this ends the chain and approves the leave.
decide.rejectMsg: They will see your reason. No days are taken from the balance.
decide.rejectInstead: It is waiting for {{who}}. You can decide it in their place. They will see your reason.
decide.rejected: Marked as not approved. They have been told.

preview.pick: Pick the leave and the dates to see which days count.
preview.summaryUnpaid: {{days}} of {{type}} — unpaid, cut from the salary
preview.freeDays_one: {{count}} day off in between isn’t counted
preview.freeDays_other: {{count}} days off in between aren’t counted
preview.lessonsMine_one: You have {{count}} lesson on these days. Once the leave is approved, the timetable office arranges a substitute.
preview.lessonsMine_other: You have {{count}} lessons on these days. Once the leave is approved, the timetable office arranges substitutes.
preview.lessonsTheirs_one: {{name}} has {{count}} lesson on these days that will need a substitute.
preview.lessonsTheirs_other: {{name}} has {{count}} lessons on these days that will need a substitute.
preview.sandwichNote: {{type}} counts the holidays and weekly offs between leave days (the sandwich rule).

apply.title: Apply for leave
apply.reasonHint: A few words — the approver sees it.
apply.arrangementHint: Who looks after your work while you are away (optional).
apply.arrangementTeacherHint: For example “Rahul takes 8-A maths”. The timetable office sees it when arranging cover (optional).
apply.approveNowHint: For leave already agreed — it skips the approval chain and goes straight onto the balance.
apply.doneFor: Leave entered for {{name}}. It now waits for {{who}}.
apply.arrangementHintTheirs: Who looks after their work while they are away (optional).
apply.arrangementTeacherHintTheirs: For example “Rahul takes 8-A maths”. The timetable office sees it when arranging cover (optional).

drawer.subtitle: Leave request
drawer.headline: {{days}} · {{dates}}
drawer.instead: Waiting for {{who}}. As someone who approves leave, you can also decide it yourself.
drawer.lessonsPending: Substitutes are arranged once the leave is approved.
drawer.daysNote: Holidays, weekly offs and school vacation in between aren’t counted, unless this leave counts them (the sandwich rule).
drawer.cancelApprovedMsg: It was approved: the {{days}} go back to the balance and come off staff attendance.
drawer.cancelPendingMsg: The request is withdrawn and the approver is told.

balances.search: Search by name or staff code…
balances.note: Each number is what is free now out of what they had this leave year. Leave waiting for a decision is already held. “Other leave” is leave HR gives when it is granted, or leave that needs no balance. Open a person to see every entry and to correct a balance.
balances.ledgerHint: Credits, leave taken and corrections, newest first. Tap a balance above to see only that leave.
balances.correctHint: Add days (for example 1.5) or take them off (for example -1). The reason is kept with the entry.
balances.openingHint: Days they already had when you started using this system, for example earned leave carried from earlier years.
balances.daysHint: Use - to take days off. Whole or half days.
balances.daysError: Whole or half days, not zero
balances.whyPlaceholder: For example: worked on the annual day, or a mistake in last year’s balance
balances.ledgerNote: Nothing is overwritten: the correction is added as its own entry, with your name and the reason.
balances.workedOnHint: A holiday, weekly off or school event day.
balances.compOffPlaceholder: For example: annual day rehearsal on Sunday
balances.compOffOnce: It can be given once for each day worked.
balances.compOffGiven: Compensatory off added to the balance.

calendar.busiest_one: at most {{count}} away on one day
calendar.busiest_other: at most {{count}} away on one day
calendar.emptyTitle: Nobody is on leave this month
calendar.emptyHint: Approved and waiting leave shows here, one row a person.

setup.title: Leave setup
setup.policiesHint: Kinds of leave and their rules

policies.intro: Each kind of leave has its own rules: how many days staff get and when, how they ask for it, what happens to unused days, and who it is for. Changes apply to new requests; leave already approved stays as it is.
policies.deleteHint: Use this for a kind of leave added by mistake. Once staff have applied for it or have days of it, it can’t be deleted — untick Active to retire it instead.
policies.name: Name
policies.codeHint: 2–4 letters payroll and reports use, like CL.
policies.codeFixed: Payroll and reports use it, so it stays as it is.
policies.descriptionHint: One line staff see when choosing it.

credit.title: How the days are given
credit.hint: When days are added to each person’s balance.
credit.different: A different number for some staff
credit.differentHint: For example 0 earned leave for teaching staff, who have the school vacations instead.
credit.addDifferent: Add staff with a different number
credit.pause: Not earned in a school vacation month
credit.pauseHint: No monthly credit in a month that is mostly school vacation for the person (Setup › No-leave days and vacations).

example.upfront: Someone here all year gets {{quota}} at the start of the leave year; someone joining today gets {{rest}}.
example.monthly: About {{perMonth}} a day is added each month — {{earned}} so far this leave year ({{months}} months).
example.confirmation: Someone confirmed gets {{quota}} a year; while on probation they get none.

asking.title: Asking for it
asking.noticeHint: A reminder for the approver when asked later — it doesn’t stop the request.
asking.noBalanceHint: It can be taken whenever needed; days taken are still counted (duty leave, leave without pay).
asking.noLeaveHint: Switch off for leave that can’t wait, like sick or maternity leave.

counting.title: Counting days
counting.sandwich: Count holidays and weekly offs in between (sandwich rule)
counting.sandwichHint: Leave on Saturday and Monday then counts the Sunday too.

yearEnd.title: Year end and pay
yearEnd.hint: What happens to unused days when the leave year ends.
yearEnd.keepAllHint: Nothing lapses at the year end.
yearEnd.carry: Days carried into the next year
yearEnd.carryHint: The rest lapse. 0 means unused days lapse.
yearEnd.paidHint: Switch off for leave without pay: the days are cut from the salary.
yearEnd.compOffHint: HR gives it for a day worked on a holiday or at a school event (Balances › Give compensatory off).

policies.inUseHint: Switch off to retire it: nobody can ask for it any more, and the history stays.

list.upfront: {{days}} a year, all at the start

chains.intro: Who approves leave, step by step. Pick which requests a chain is for — a kind of leave, a department, teaching or other staff, long leave — and up to five steps. The chain with the highest priority that fits a request is used.
chains.defaultNote: When no chain fits, a request goes to the person they report to; when they have none, to the principal / HR. Anyone who approves leave can also decide any request in place of the step’s approver. Nobody approves their own leave.
chains.name: Name
chains.namePlaceholder: For example: Long leave for teachers
chains.priorityHint: Higher wins when two chains fit.
chains.inUseHint: Switch off to stop using it. Requests already on their way keep their chain.
chains.appliesToHint: Leave a list empty for any.
chains.minDays: Only for leave of at least (days)
chains.minDaysHint: For example 3, so a long leave also goes to the principal.
chains.more: When a step can’t be decided
chains.skip: Skip a step only the person on leave could approve, or already approved earlier
chains.skipHint: A head of department asking for leave doesn’t approve their own step, and nobody approves twice.
chains.moveOnHint: When a step waits this long without a decision, it goes to the next step. Leave empty to wait.
chains.selfNote: A request keeps the chain it started with — changing a chain here doesn’t move requests already on their way.
chains.emptyHint: Requests go to the reporting manager, else the principal / HR.
chains.deleteMsg: New requests will use another chain, or the usual one. Requests already on their way keep this chain.

noLeave.intro: Set the days when staff shouldn’t take leave — exams, the annual day, parent–teacher meetings — and the school vacations. Sick and maternity leave aren’t affected unless their policy says so.
noLeave.title: No-leave days
noLeave.subtitle: Leave asked for on these days is warned about, needs the principal or HR, or isn’t allowed.
noLeave.vacationSub: Not working days for the staff they cover: leave isn’t counted on them, and monthly earned leave pauses.
noLeave.name: Name

modes.WARN: Allow, with a warning to the approver
modes.HR: Allow only with the principal’s or HR’s approval
modes.BLOCK: Don’t allow — only HR can enter it

modeHint.WARN: Staff can still ask; the approver sees that it falls on these days.
modeHint.HR: A last step for the principal / HR is added to the request’s approval.
modeHint.BLOCK: Staff can’t ask for leave on these days. HR can still enter leave for an emergency.

noLeave.whoHint: Tick none for every member of staff.
noLeave.whoVacationHint: Usually teaching staff — office and support staff often work through the vacation.
noLeave.ideasSub: Exams, events and parent–teacher meetings coming up.
noLeave.deleteMsg: Leave already asked for stays as it is.

yearEnd.intro: When a leave year ends, the unused days above each policy’s carry-forward limit lapse and the rest move into the new year. This happens by itself for each person on the first day of the new year; here you can see what it will do and bring everyone up to date at once.
yearEnd.allDone_one: {{count}} member of staff is up to date for this year.
yearEnd.allDone_other: All {{count}} staff are up to date for this year.
yearEnd.notYet_one: {{count}} of {{total}} staff hasn’t been brought up to date for this year yet.
yearEnd.notYet_other: {{count}} of {{total}} staff haven’t been brought up to date for this year yet.
yearEnd.lapsedThen_one: At the start of the year {{days}} lapsed for {{count}} person.
yearEnd.lapsedThen_other: At the start of the year {{days}} lapsed for {{count}} people.
yearEnd.nothingLapsed: Nothing lapsed at the start of the year.
yearEnd.runHint: Bringing everyone up to date adds this year’s credits and last year’s lapses for anyone not done yet. Running it again adds nothing twice.
yearEnd.runTitle: Bring every balance up to date for {{year}}?
yearEnd.runMsg: This year’s credits and last year’s lapses are added for anyone who doesn’t have them yet. Nothing is added twice.
yearEnd.ran_one: {{count}} balance checked and brought up to date.
yearEnd.ran_other: {{count}} people’s balances checked and brought up to date.
yearEnd.comingSub: From today’s balances, with requests waiting counted as taken. The rest is carried into {{next}}.
yearEnd.empty: Nobody has unused days in leave that carries forward.
yearEnd.note: To change a limit, open the leave in Setup › Leave policies. A balance can be corrected from Balances.
